title: Your Module Name
description: One sentence: what this department/module does and what the user should do here.

sections.title: Overview
sections.description: The main inputs the user should fill in first.

blocks.title: How To Use This Module
blocks.text:
## Start here
- Fill in the core goal
- Set the status
- Keep the next action current

blocks.title: Start Here
blocks.text: Use this first card for the main task or intake area.

blocks.title: Checklist Preview
blocks.empty: Write checklist-style lines in Task List to preview them here.

blocks.title: Task Board
blocks.empty: Use [Lane] task or checklist-style lines in Task List to preview them here as a board.

sections.title: Notes & Context
sections.description: Useful supporting detail, references, risks, or working notes.

blocks.title: Quick Summary
blocks.empty: Fill in a few fields to surface a quick summary here.

blocks.title: Recent Module Files
blocks.empty: No files have been created in this module folder yet.

blocks.title: Artifact Preview
blocks.empty: Point a field at a module-local file path to preview it here.

blocks.title: Structured Notes Table
blocks.empty: If Notes contains CSV/TSV/pipe-style rows, they will preview here as a table.

blocks.title: Activity Timeline

blocks.title: Dependency Map
blocks.empty: Add lines like Intake -> Draft -> Review if you want the dependency flow to render here.

fields.label: Goal
fields.placeholder: What are you trying to achieve in this module?
fields.help: Write the outcome in plain language so the user and orchestrator can both understand it.

fields.label: Status
fields.help: Pick the option that best matches where this department is up to.

fields.label: Notes
fields.placeholder: Paste references, constraints, results, links, etc.
fields.help: This is the main scratch area for important details worth keeping with the module.

fields.label: Task list
fields.placeholder:
- [ ] First step
[Doing] Draft handoff
[x] Done item
fields.help: Use checklist-style lines or [Lane] task lines if you want the Checklist Preview and Task Board blocks to render them nicely.

fields.label: Risk level
fields.help: Use this when another module or the orchestrator should treat the work carefully.

fields.label: Time budget (minutes)
fields.help: Optional, but useful for planning modules that need to coordinate with each other.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.help: Untick this if you want the module to stay available on disk but effectively inactive.

fields.label: Artifact path
fields.help: Use a relative path inside the module folder if you want Artifact Preview to show it.

fields.label: Activity log
fields.placeholder:
09:00 | Started research
11:30 | Exported findings
15:00 | Sent handoff
fields.help: Use timeline-style lines if you want the Activity Timeline block to render them nicely.

fields.label: Dependency map
fields.placeholder:
Intake -> Draft
Draft -> Review
Review -> Handoff
fields.help: Use simple A -> B lines if you want the Dependency Map block to render them as a staged graph.

fields.label: Next action
fields.placeholder: One sentence: what you will do next.
fields.help: This is especially helpful for automatic suspend rundowns.
